name: Amrita Hospital, Kochi
summary: Amrita Hospital in Kochi is a university teaching hospital at Ponekkara, inaugurated in 1998, with more than 1,300 beds. Its international healthcare service offers round-the-clock support, translation help and visa assistance.
highlights: The first university teaching hospital in India to receive NABH accreditation, per the hospital
Laboratory accredited by NABL; stroke centre certified by NABH and the World Stroke Organisation
International patient service with translation help and visa assistance
Neonatology unit recognised at Level III by the National Neonatology Forum
